rho_reference.protocol: Supplied after the measurement, to meet the validation gate: the study registered no rho reference because it measures one stage. The thread reference of RESEARCH_RESIDUAL_WALKS.md §11.16 is plain r-adding rho (rho4, S about 1.3) priced in F_p multiplications; this uses the stricter one the same protocol unit admits: one-target negation-map rho on the §11.17 curve itself (p = 269, seed 1, #E = 189 * 27703979), in its prime subgroup, 20 runs, every logarithm verified. Negation is the strongest symmetry on this curve: j(E) is not in F_p^2 and a, b != 0 (validation/curve_info.json). IC side is a lower bound: one measured decomposition (C4, sparsest + chains + replay), without the other decompositions, the linear algebra or any unpriced work. Rho unpriced native work per run: one table lookup, one insert and one partition hash per step and one canonicalisation and one hash per walk attempt (5 steps + 2 look-aheads), priced at w group-addition equivalents of 97 F_p multiplications each.
rho_reference.binary_or_process: examples/gaudry_quartic_c4_options: the rho runs ran in its build of ca88b3917; the C4 records come from the original build (cb2ec6873 plus the PlainOptions wrapper), and the ca88b3917 build reproduced every C4 count of those records exactly (validation/replay-certificate.json), so both arms are counted by the same binary and the same Fp4 counters
